rootCause: The atomic PortCo after-images correctly changed company and ownership-period identity fields but intentionally do not overwrite the independent OwnershipPeriod fund-attribution metadata. Existing ECP periods preserved older INFERRED metadata, while the new Harvestone Group period retained the default UNRESOLVED state even though the reviewed seed attribution manifest contains the correct classifications.
containment: The batch ledger moved from VERIFYING to VERIFYING_FAILED. No subsequent release bundle may start until a protected attribution-only correction updates the six affected current ownership periods and renewed API and rendered-card verification passes.
